notes: Catalogue generalises well: 136/150 fit as-is. Only gap is the genetic cross (2.5.4, 6 marks), a P2 staple (expect 1-2 per paper, monohybrid or dihybrid, sometimes Punnett). Genetics brings notation P1 never had: superscript alleles (I^A I^B, X^r) and case-significant genotypes (dd/Dd/DD) where the term type's spelling tolerance and any case-folding would mark wrong answers right. The same tolerance also accepts near-miss opposites ('discontinuous', 'complete dominance', 'Prophase II'), so term needs a reject list. All shared context is covered: pedigree, DNA bands, bar graph, distribution graphs, map, protein-synthesis and cell diagrams are images; brain-volume and plant tables are read-only tables; procedure and ratite extract are text. 3.2.4 steps approximates the formula-substitution mark with an intermediate number. 2.4.3 hides a calculation inside a 2-mark choice; mcq covers it. No draw or graph-plot item in this paper.
